title: Zesty Spicy Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A spicy and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring lamb, green salsa, and a cheesy pull, all wood-fired-baked to perfection, this paleo-friendly recipe is a must try for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, cumin, and coriander.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pot and cook until fragrant.
Add the lamb shoulder to the pot and sear until browned on all sides.
Add the green salsa, cherry tomatoes, and feta cheese to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated wood-fired oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours or until the lamb is tender and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the pot from the oven and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
